Description:
Ballistics of the 25x137mm XM881 APFSDS-T. Projectile travel is 74 inch (1880mm), chamber volume 5.86 cubic inch (0.096L), projectile weighs 0.17 lbs, loads 0.207 lbs of M10 7 perforated grains. 

Develops 41.735 ksi maximum breech pressure and 4584 ft/s muzzle velocity, propellant remains unburnt at the instance of projectile exit.

IBHVG models heat loss to barrel surface while PIBS does not. A manual downward adjustment of propellant force is required to match the reference ballistics.

Loss Table from IBHVG2 User Guide:
- Gas Internal: 53.91%
- Gas Kinetic: 7.47%
- Projectile Kinetic: 20.26%
- Projectile Rotation: 0.16%
- Frictional: 0.70%
- Air: 0.47%
- Heat Conducted to Bore: 17.04%

References:
- ADB117104 IBHVG2-A USER'S GUIDE (1987)
